final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, n AS qc_count, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM c) AS ratio_to_avg FROM c ORDER BY n DESC
